questions.q: How did the family of Uthman bin Affan torture him?
options: They rolled him in a mat and set it on fire
They locked him in a cave
They drove him into the desert
questions.explain: His family tortured him to make him leave the Prophet SAW, but he did not.

questions.q: Where did Suhaib Ar-Rumi come from?
questions.explain: Suhaib was a companion from Rome who was beaten until unconscious.

questions.q: Why was Mus'ab bin Umayr famous in Makkah?
options: For his clothes, perfume and beautiful voice
questions.explain: Mus'ab was a rich young man, like an influencer in Makkah.

options: The steadfastness of the tortured companions
questions.explain: Mus'ab saw the steadfastness of Bilal and others, and his clean heart accepted the truth.

questions.q: Who told Mus'ab's mother that her son had embraced Islam?
questions.explain: Uthman bin Talhah saw Mus'ab pray and told his mother.

questions.q: What did Mus'ab's mother do when she learnt he had embraced Islam?
options: She chained and locked him in a small room
She drove him away at once
questions.explain: Mus'ab was chained in a small room with little food, but he did not turn back.

questions.q: What was Allah's recompense to Ummu Anmar who burned Khabbab?
options: She was struck by an illness treated with fire

questions.q: The Prophet SAW told Mus'ab to keep his Islam secret for a while because of the threats.
questions.explain: True. There was wisdom in keeping it secret for a time.

questions.q: Mus'ab was willing to leave the Prophet SAW to get his wealth back.
questions.explain: False. Mus'ab told them to take all his wealth but would not leave the Prophet SAW.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Uthman is rolled up and burned
The Prophet SAW answers Abu Talib
Uthman bin Talhah tells the mother

questions.explain: Uthman was tortured, Mus'ab embraced Islam, was reported, locked up, and finally the Prophet SAW answered Abu Talib.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The secret house where the Prophet SAW taught his companions
One who dies defending his faith
A successor of the Prophet SAW leading the ummah

questions.explain: A shahid dies defending the faith, a khalifah succeeds the Prophet SAW, a screwpine mat is woven from leaves, and Dar al-Arqam was the secret house.

questions.q: Even a rich and high-ranking person is tested. What is the lesson from this story?
options: Not only the weak, the rich and high-ranking are tested too
Tests are a sign of Allah's anger
questions.explain: Uthman and Mus'ab were rich and well-placed men who were also tortured.
